subject: Cannot log in after password reset
body: Login button not working on mobile.

subject: PDF export broken
body: Export to PDF fails silently.

subject: Performance issue on dashboard
body: Dashboard loads slowly.

subject: Password reset not working
body: Can't reset password.

subject: UI typo on billing settings page
body: Typo on billing page.

subject: Date filter not persisting
body: Date filter not saving preferences.

subject: Bulk CSV import only saving partial records
body: We have been experiencing a critical issue with our data synchronization pipeline that began approximately 72 hours ago. When our sales team attempts to import bulk contact records using the CSV upload feature, the process appears to complete successfully (progress bar reaches 100%, success toast notification appears), however upon inspecting the CRM contacts list, fewer than 30% of the records appear to have been saved. We have attempted the following troubleshooting steps: cleared browser cache, tried Chrome and Firefox, reduced file size to under 500 rows, disabled all browser extensions, and contacted our IT team to verify no firewall rules are blocking outbound requests. The issue persists across all attempts. This is severely impacting our Q3 pipeline review scheduled for Friday. We urgently need this resolved. Attached is a sanitized version of one of the failing CSV files and a HAR network log captured during a failed upload attempt.

subject: Invoice amount discrepancy — urgent compliance matter
body: Our finance team discovered a discrepancy in the invoicing module during our monthly close process. Invoice #INV-20240912 was sent to the client with a line item total of $84,500 but our internal records show the agreed contract value was $76,200. We believe this may be related to a currency conversion issue since this client is billed in EUR and we recently updated our exchange rate settings. We have already apologized to the client and issued a credit note, but we need your team to (1) investigate the root cause of the calculation error, (2) confirm whether any other invoices in the September batch are affected, and (3) provide an audit trail showing when the exchange rate configuration was changed and by whom. This is a compliance-sensitive matter for us. Please treat with high priority.

subject: Positive feedback + chat widget disconnect issue
body: I want to report a positive experience with your support team regarding ticket #TKT-00198. The agent who handled our case was thorough, responsive, and went above and beyond to help us configure the custom reporting module. The documentation for calculated fields was initially confusing but the step-by-step walkthrough made everything clear. That said, I would like to flag one area for improvement: the in-app chat widget has a tendency to disconnect during longer sessions (anything over 15 minutes), which means we sometimes lose context mid-conversation. Small quality of life issue but worth noting.

subject: Multiple onboarding configuration questions
body: Following up on our onboarding call from last week. We are a 200-person manufacturing company newly migrated from a legacy CRM and are encountering several configuration challenges. Specifically: (1) Our sales territories are structured around regional managers with overlapping account assignments — the territory management module does not appear to support many-to-many relationships between reps and accounts. (2) Our product catalog has approximately 4,200 SKUs with tiered pricing by customer segment; importing this via the standard product import template failed with a schema validation error on rows 847 and 1203 (error message: "invalid value for field 'price_tier' — expected integer, got string"). (3) We need our deal stages to map to our existing ERP workflow stages for financial reporting purposes — is there a field mapping or API endpoint we can use? Our IT team is standing by to implement any recommended configuration changes.

subject: API rate limit errors during peak hours
body: We are hitting 429 errors on the contacts endpoint between 9–11am EST daily. Our sync job runs every 15 minutes. Please advise on rate limit tiers and backoff strategy.

subject: Duplicate contacts appearing after import
body: After each nightly sync, we see approximately 15-20 duplicate contact records created. De-dupe logic appears to match on email only, missing phone-number-only records.

subject: SSO configuration not working with Okta
body: Our IT admin has followed the SAML 2.0 setup guide but users are getting a redirect loop after authenticating with Okta. Works fine with direct login.

subject: Feature request: bulk tag editing
body: It would save our team significant time if we could apply or remove tags across multiple selected contacts at once from the list view, rather than editing each record individually.

subject: Report export times out for large date ranges
body: Exporting the 'All Deals' report with a 12-month date range times out at approximately 90 seconds. Works fine for 30-day ranges.

subject: Webhook not firing on deal stage change
body: We configured a webhook to POST to our Zapier URL when a deal moves to 'Closed Won', but no events are being received. Tested the endpoint manually and it responds correctly.

subject: Mobile app crashes on deal view
body: App crashes immediately when tapping into any deal with more than 5 custom fields. Reproducible on iOS 17.4, iPhone 14. Crash log attached.

subject: Currency display showing wrong symbol
body: All deal values are displaying with a $ symbol even though our account currency is set to GBP. Affects both the web app and API responses.

subject: Can not delete archived campaign
body: Getting a 403 error when trying to permanently delete an archived campaign. The delete button is visible but clicking it returns: 'Permission denied: campaign has associated analytics data.'

subject: Training request for new sales team members
body: We have 8 new reps starting next month and would like to schedule a 60-minute onboarding session covering contact management, deal tracking, and reporting basics. Please let us know your availability.

subject: Data not refreshing in real-time dashboard
body: The live pipeline dashboard appears to be cached — deal values and stage counts are delayed by up to 45 minutes even after manual refresh.

subject: Custom field not appearing in reports
body: We added a custom field 'Contract Type' to the Deals object two weeks ago and it is not available as a filter or column in any report builder. All other custom fields appear correctly.

subject: Billing charge discrepancy
body: Our card was charged $1,249 this month but our plan should be $999/month. We did not add any seats or upgrade features. Please provide a detailed invoice breakdown.

subject: Email sequence not sending after step 3
body: Automated email sequences stop sending after the third email regardless of the configured delay. Steps 1 and 2 deliver correctly. We have rebuilt the sequence twice with the same result.

subject: Request for data export before contract ends
body: Our contract ends on December 31. We need a full export of all contacts, deals, notes, activities, and email logs in CSV or JSON format before the offboarding deadline.
